title: Count Subarrays With Fixed Bounds
summary: Given an integer array nums and two integers minK and maxK, count the number of subarrays where the minimum value equals minK and the maximum value equals maxK.
statement: Given an integer array nums and two integers minK and maxK, count the number of subarrays where the minimum value equals minK and the maximum value equals maxK.
constraints: nums has at least two integers and min_k <= max_k.
Count contiguous subarrays whose minimum is exactly min_k and maximum is exactly max_k.
Values outside [min_k,max_k] invalidate every subarray crossing their position.
reference_solution:
def count_fixed_bound_subarrays(nums,min_k,max_k):
    invalid=last_min=last_max=-1;answer=0
    for index,value in enumerate(nums):
        if value<min_k or value>max_k:invalid=index
        if value==min_k:last_min=index
        if value==max_k:last_max=index
        answer+=max(0,min(last_min,last_max)-invalid)
    return answer

Track the last positions of min_k, max_k, and any out-of-range value.
A start after the invalid index stays within range, while a start at or before both bound positions includes each required extreme; their intersection has exactly the computed size.
